items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: So, Bob Lyons, he had a shoe black stand on Ramport and Perdita... Bob brings me up... I want you to come over here.

ctx.x: You were telling me you came home, something about Big Eye Louie came. C-Mell and a saxophone. Oh, yeah. Came off the open circuit.

So, Bob Lyons, he had a shoe black stand on Ramport and Perdita. Well, that's where all the positioners' headquarters was. When they'd get up in the daytime, they'd go around Bob Lyons and have their fun. So, Bob brings me up. Old Rivers, look. Say, I want you to come over here. I got something nice I want to tell you about. I was anxious to know this about it. Come over and say, listen. Say, Big Eye Louie come in town with a saxophone. C-Mell and a saxophone. And he says that he pawned it. Yeah. Well, I go and…
He used to play with Big Eye out at the Luchin's.

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Joe Oliver, Bob Lyons, Lorenzo Stahl.

ctx.x: Well, I think he was older. Joe was older.
Because Joe was too old for the number one war. Is that right? Joe Oliver, Bob Lyons, Lorenzo Stahl.
Well, or his drummer was very happy. He was too young.
